name: Kuma Will
source:
"Hehe, we did it!!"

A second-year high school student who is the class mood maker. He has many male friends regardless of what grade they're in.

He has strong beast blood and enjoys primitive activities. Exercising usually helps him let it all out. He loves salmon and Ishikari Nabe, a local Japanese dish.

The feeling that makes him turn back into a beast is "anger." [spoiler]He was able to overcome it in the past with therapy, but a new feeling called 'jealousy' triggered him once again.[/spoiler]

[Translated from in-game profile]
